version_axes.breaking_when: public source/binary compatibility or supported runtime changes
meaning, applicability, quantity/unit/sign, required input/check or outcome meaning changes
required/typed structure or unknown-field compatibility changes
expected leaf set, applicability or named default changes
source edition/amendment, table node, interpolation/cap or rule implementation changes
controlled tables, names, calculation/migration behavior or required add-in changes
host method/return shape, transaction, receipt or supported host tuple changes
issued package structure/presentation changes without changing semantic calculation data

rules: Results and receipts record every version axis that can affect their meaning or replay.
Package SemVer does not hide code-data/profile/schema changes; compatibility matrix declares accepted combinations.
Compatible additions are optional, have no engineering default effect and preserve canonical old effective inputs/results.
A corrected unsafe ambiguity receives a new semantic major and the legacy wrapper rejects unresolved use; compatibility never recreates a known wrong result.
Deprecation lasts at least two published minor releases and six months before major removal unless continuing behavior is unsafe; removal dates and alternatives are published at first warning.
Reproducible past calculations retain exact old code-data/profile/schema artifacts or return a clear non-replayable state; they are never recalculated silently with new rules.
